findings.quote: The decision to sell was made
findings.note: The noun decision buries the verb decide; was made is a weak passive (be plus make) carrying the action.
The noun evaluation buries the verb evaluate; carried out is an empty verb standing in for the action.
The noun bottleneck buries the verb bottleneck, and the clause leans on the empty verb is.

findings.quote: By the time I reached the top of the hill that February,
findings.note: Late subject: twelve words before the subject 'I'.

findings.quote: After eleven years of sitting in morning traffic behind a school bus,
findings.note: 12 words before the subject 'I'.
The stock phrase delays the content without adding meaning.
'very' is an intensifier that adds emphasis without changing the claim.
'picturesque' appears twice within one sentence; the first occurrence is 'a picturesque row' earlier in that sentence.
The word 'cleared' is repeated. Its first occurrence in this paragraph is in 'are cleared first'.
The noun determination buries the verb determine, and the empty verb makes carries the clause.
The clause leans on the weak passive verb 'be noted' instead of naming who notes the fact.
The noun 'approval' buries the verb 'approve'; the clause verb 'recorded' carries little of the action.
The noun criticism buries the verb criticize, and the weak verb is carries the clause.
The noun attempt buries the verb attempt, and the weak verb is carries the clause.
The noun review buries the verb review, carried by the empty verb conduct.
The draft never says who made the 2023 decision that all changes would use this process; the deciding actor is missing.
The draft never says who raised the concerns about the delays. The reader cannot tell whether it was the product teams, the board, or someone else.

findings.quote: This memo proposes that we move release approval from the weekly Change Advisory Board to the lead of each product team.
findings.note: placeholder
Run of three consecutive sentences opening with the same two words, 'The board'.

findings.quote: Given the results of the pilot and what both teams told us in the May retrospective,
findings.note: Sixteen words before the subject 'I'.
Clearly adds a claim of obviousness.
'quite' adds emphasis without changing the fact or certainty of the claim.
'really' is a single intensifier adding emphasis.
The word "oversight" recurs; the first occurrence is in "remove oversight from our release process" two sentences earlier.
The noun 'decision' buries the verb 'decide', carried by the weak verb 'made'.
The noun 'wake-up call' buries the verb 'wake', and the clause rests on the weak verb 'was'.

findings.quote: Flood warnings for Quay Street were not issued
findings.note: The draft never says who was responsible for issuing the flood warnings. The delayed warning is a failure the paragraph is about, and no actor is named nearby.
The draft never says who promised the sandbags. The broken promise is a decision the text holds someone to, but the responsible party is missing.

findings.quote: For the street, the flood was a wake-up call
findings.note: placeholder
The noun determination buries the verb determine. The clause leans on the weak verb phrase would be made.
The noun feeling buries the verb feel; the clause rests on the weak verb is.
The noun feeling buries the verb feel; the clause rests on the weak verb is.
The noun "decision" buries the verb "decide." The clause's action is carried by the weak verb form "be made."
The draft never says who was to accomplish anything. The actor is left implicit.
The stock phrase 'made the observation that' delays the content without adding meaning.
